title: Konclave collaboration policy source v2
description: Editable deterministic policy source, not active authority. Compilation creates canonical bytes; a separate explicit local decision activates a conversation binding. Authoring and activation workflow: https://github.com/nexus-software-laboratories/konclave/blob/main/policy/README.md

apiVersion.description: Selects source format v2, which rejects model guidance and task instructions. This is not a wire, package or storage version.

kind.description: Selects a collaboration-policy document, not a catalog or executable workflow.

metadata.description: Policy naming metadata; neither its presence nor its name grants authority.

name.description: Canonical lowercase policy name, at most 128 characters. The name is not the compiled bundle's content digest.

spec.description: Deterministic statements, required evidence and usage limits. No model guidance or task instructions are accepted.

statements.description: Up to 256 statements, sorted by unique identifier during compilation. Omission means no statements; an action without a matching statement is denied.

requiredHarnessClaims.description: Up to 64 namespaced claims that must all be independently proven by the local harness. Declaring a claim is not evidence; missing proof denies. Exact-target harness control is also required.

limits.description: Usage limits resolved against caller-supplied defaults. Omitting this object inherits all defaults; an empty object also inherits them.

canonicalIdentifier.description: Lowercase ASCII alphanumeric segments with interior hyphens or underscores, separated by dots or slashes. Spelling is canonical, not normalized.

namespacedIdentifier.description: Canonical identifier containing a dot or slash, at most 256 characters. Matching is exact, with no glob, hierarchy or filesystem interpretation.

statement.description: One exact action/resource rule. Among matching rules, deny precedes require_local_approval, which precedes allow; local restrictions can only narrow authority.

id.description: Canonical statement identifier, at most 128 characters and unique within the compiled bundle. It identifies the statement, not an action permission.

effect.description: allow permits only after local authority, proven claims/controls and limits pass. deny refuses even with approval. require_local_approval requires fresh local approval after those checks; approval cannot override denial, missing evidence or exhausted limits.

action.description: Exact namespaced action selector. A matching rule alone does not grant local authority or prove harness enforcement.

resource.description: Exact namespaced resource selector. Omission or null matches only an unscoped action, never every resource.

optionalPositiveInteger.description: Positive u64 integer from 1 through 18446744073709551615, or null for unlimited. Omission inherits the caller's default; zero is invalid. Unlimited never removes independent parser, frame, queue, journal or storage hard bounds.

limits.description: Each omitted field inherits its caller default independently. Explicit null removes that policy limit, not ordinary authorization checks or independent hard bounds.

durationMilliseconds.description: Elapsed duration in milliseconds, not seconds. A finite policy duration expires when elapsed time reaches this limit.

turns.description: Maximum turn usage; existing usage plus the prospective reservation must fit the finite limit.

tokens.description: Maximum token usage; existing usage plus the prospective reservation must fit the finite limit.

concurrentRequests.description: Maximum concurrent-request usage including the prospective reservation: positive u32 from 1 through 4294967295. Omission inherits the caller default; null is unlimited within independent hard bounds; zero is invalid.
